caption:
This entire waterbending scene was built by AI. No CGI, no film studio, no special effects team.

The creator already went viral with an AI desert scene, and this water version pushes it further. The fluid physics, the light reflections, the way water curls and splashes. All generated from scratch by a machine that taught itself how liquids move.
